description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) in PyTorch, including mixed precision policies, communication primitives, and offloading policies.

classes.name: MixedPrecisionPolicy
classes.description: Configures FSDP's mixed precision at the module level, including dtype attributes and casting options.

classes.name: Comm
classes.description: Abstract interface for communication primitives used in distributed training.

classes.name: OffloadPolicy
classes.description: Base class representing no offloading policy.

classes.name: CPUOffloadPolicy
classes.description: Offloading policy that moves parameters, gradients, and optimizer states to CPU with configurable pin_memory.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Abstract method for allocating communication buffers.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Abstract method for all_gather communication primitive.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Abstract method for reduce_scatter communication primitive.
